subject: english
stem: An eleven-year-old arrives alone for the Lake Trail at 09:15. May the child use it?
options: Yes, because the East Gate is open.
Yes, because two rest areas exist.
No, only because the soup is hot.
No; the trail is closed, and the child also needs an adult.

optionRationales.reason: Yes, because the East Gate is open.：跨列且忽略年齡。
Yes, because two rest areas exist.：設施數量不改變限制。
No, only because the soup is hot.：菜單與步道資格無關。
No; the trail is closed, and the child also needs an adult.：時刻表 CLOSED 與 under 12 need adult 兩條都不合。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「主表或圖表提供的數值與 NOTE 限制同時套用後只剩一個可行方案」可推出 No; the trail is closed, and the child also needs an adult.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 No; the trail is closed, and the child also needs an adult. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
